name: Hotel-Garni Hubertushof
beschreibung: The Hotel-Garni Hubertushof is located in Tirol and offers accommodation without dinner. The surroundings are characterized by mountains and nature, with numerous hiking trails in summer. In winter, several ski areas are within easy reach. The house has rooms with balconies and free Wi-Fi. Amenities include a breakfast room, a sauna, and parking. The atmosphere is quiet and family-like. Guests can expect basic accommodation with breakfast and good access to outdoor activities.
